verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Financial Connections lets you 'Access an account's current and available balances' and 'reduce underwriting risk with balances data', with a dedicated balance-refresh webhook event, and community evidence confirms real customers use the linked-account data as a fraud/risk signal before ACH debits. This matches the NSF/risk-check use case described in the story. missing for 10: explicit API reference/endpoint schema for the balance object, and confirmation of real-time (vs refresh-triggered) latency guarantees.
